Static <hr class=secsep> cleanly separates the alarm section from What Left onward. Engine unchanged from v5.2 except no changes — v5.2 build_data.py carried forward. v5.2 (2026-08-13): THREE FIXES. (1) PHYSICAL-DATE RULE — movement rows are now dated by when material moved, not when a human keyed the transaction: Receipts/Bills use Date Received, Transfers use Date Picked then Date Sent, Returns/Adjustments/POs keep Date. Measured impact on the 05-11..08-11 build: 3,697 of 13,423 ledger rows (27.5%) were sitting on the wrong day, shifts running -1 to -34 days; the 08-04 receipt spike (356 rows) redistributed across 08-03..08-11 into a believable daily rhythm. The keyed date is retained on the row as "dk" when it differs so entry lag stays visible. (2) UNEXPLAINED TILE IS NOW WINDOW-SCOPED — unexpItems() split into winUnexpItems() (window adjustments) and standingItems() (month-anchor residuals, dead-location balances, fleet snapshot flags). Previously all three standing groups were appended unconditionally, so Yesterday / Trailing 3 / 7 / 30 / MTD every rendered an IDENTICAL Unexplained figure and item count. The tile now shows the window value with standing broken out beneath it, and the work list renders two labelled groups. Item keys are UNCHANGED so no saved note is orphaned. (3) NEW TRAILING-90 INVOICE COLUMNS CONSUMED — Job ID (verified 226/226 against the movement export) lifts ServiceTitan deep links from MTD-only to 8,411 jobs across the full 90 days; ServiceTitan Equipment Type resolves units the name classifier could not place (Unspecified fell to zero, Other Equipment to 3) via ST_EQTYPE, used ONLY to resolve unknowns so locked variance baselines cannot shift; Serial Number and Installed On captured per unit on inv_eq (1,022 serials / 1,106 install dates on 1,107 rows). Movement rows also carry Quantity on Transaction, Job ID and Approval Status when the 48-column export is present — the engine reads every new column by name and degrades silently on the old 39-column schema, so nightly runs work either way.
